The '''Ceremonial bowcaster''' was a specialized [[Bowcaster/Legends|bowcaster]] developed by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] to be used in ceremonial hunts. It was considered an impressive weapon for its time that did not require any further improvements.
